                                              BOARD OF DIRECTORS
                                       SPECIAL MEETING NOTICE AND AGENDA
                                           STRATEGIC PLAN WORKSHOP


Date: March 9, 2026
Time: 9:30 AM
Place: Board Room, Tahoe-Truckee Sanitation Agency, 13720 Butterfield Drive, Truckee, California

The Board will only accept public comments on the matter posted on the agenda until the close of the public comment
accommodate members of the public and staff, some Agenda items may be considered in an order different from
those listed below.

I.     Call to Order, Roll Call, and Pledge of Allegiance
       At this time, please silence phones and other electronic devices so as not to disrupt the business
       of the meeting.

II.    Public Comment
       Any member of the public may address the Board at this time on the matter posted on the agenda. No
       other business shall be considered (GC §54956).

III.   Strategic Plan Workshop Agenda
       1.      Introductions.
       2.      Norms, Values, and Principles of Governance
       3.      Break
       4.      Strategic Plan

IV.    Adjournment


                                                     Emailed and Posted. 03/05/2026.



                                                     Roshelle Chavez
                                                     Executive Assistant/Board Clerk

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you are a disabled person and need a disability-related modification or accommodation to
participate in this meeting, please email Roshelle Chavez or call 530-587-2525. Requests must be made as early as possible and at least one full
business day before the start of the meeting.

Documents and materials relating to an open session agenda item provided to the T-TSA Board of Directors less than 72 hours prior to a regular
meeting will be available for public inspection and copying at the Agency’s office, located at 13720 Butterfield Drive, Truckee, CA.
